interpretation: A causal GRU boundary tagger trained only on normalized delimiter-free program streams of depth 1-3 extrapolates exact segmentation to depth 4-10. Runtime receives one concatenated token stream rather than an externally supplied operation list/boundary sequence. Across three source pools, segmentation and routing are exact for all 3000 programs; E2E is 2995/3000. All five misses occur in seed311 while segmentation/routing remain exact, so they are source-execution errors rather than boundary errors.
claim_boundary: Opaque command pairs are already behaviorally grounded and normalized to abstract command markers before the segmenter sees the stream. The stage grammar family is synthetic and represented during segmenter training. The initial scalar state is externally given. This removes explicit runtime stage boundaries, not raw natural-language parsing or latent action-state discovery.
